whatIs: unlumen UI is a component library for React built with Tailwind CSS and Motion, with animations, image effects, shader backgrounds, navigation and animated icons.
It's a good fit when you want to give a landing page or an app a more expressive finish and you already work with React and Tailwind.
uses: Bringing a landing page to life with animated backgrounds and marketing sections.
Replacing a static navigation bar with one with smooth transitions.
Adding animated icons and small entrance effects to an existing interface.
caveats: The catalog mixes free and Pro components; check each one's label before planning to use it.
The components depend on Motion and Tailwind, so they add to your project's weight.
Pro plans are one-time or annual payments; the annual one stops giving access to new components when it expires.
pricingNote: There are free components; Pro ones unlock with a license from $69 a year or $119 as a one-time payment.
idealFor: React projects looking for ready-made animations and visual effects.
